name: IRAN

flag.title: Flag of Iran
flag.note: Green, white & red with the Allah emblem

lead: Iran lies in the Middle East. The Persian Empire once ruled from Egypt to India. Today Iran has sand deserts, snowy mountains, and saffron fields. People have lived here for more than 7,000 years.

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Iran is a high plateau ringed by mountains. Mount Damavand, a snow-capped volcano, is taller than any Alpine peak. The Zagros Mountains stretch 1,500 km like a great spine.
Two giant deserts fill the centre. Dasht-e Lut is one of the hottest places on Earth. The north hugs the Caspian Sea, which is green and rainy.
animals: Iran's Asiatic cheetah is the rarest cat on Earth. Fewer than 30 survive in the wild, all in Iran. Persian leopards prowl the Alborz forests.
Flamingos turn Lake Urmia pink every spring. Brown bears fish in mountain streams each autumn. The Persian fallow deer was thought extinct, then found again.
culture: Iranians quote the poets Hafez and Rumi like song lyrics. At Nowruz (New Year), families set a table with seven symbolic items. They also leap over bonfires.
Carpet-weaving is a 2,500-year-old art. One fine carpet can take three weavers two years. Iran grows 90% of the world's saffron, red threads from purple crocuses.
history: Cyrus the Great founded the Persian Empire around 550 BC. It was the largest empire the ancient world had seen. Cyrus also issued one of history's first human-rights declarations.
Alexander, the Parthians, and the Sassanids ruled Iran in turn. Later, Iran became the heart of the Islamic Golden Age. Its scholars pioneered algebra and medicine.
wows: Mount Damavand is Asia's highest volcano, at 5,610 m.
Couriers ran 2,700 km along Cyrus the Great's postal network, history's first.
Yazd's wind-towers (badgir) cooled buildings 2,500 years before air conditioning.
Iran grows roughly 90% of the world's saffron.
Iran has the last wild cheetahs outside Africa.
Backgammon was invented in Persia about 5,000 years ago.
Iran's underground qanat channels have watered the plateau for over 3,000 years.

myths.myth: Persia and Iran are different countries
myths.fact: Same country. In 1935, Iran asked the world to stop saying Persia.
It comes from the Persian shah mat, meaning the king is helpless. Chess reached Europe through Persia.
